Source: He has been sick the past week with diarrhea and has been staying home from work.
A 44-year-old man presents to the emergency department acutely confused.
He is otherwise healthy and does not take any medications.
He is able to drink oral fluids and protect his airway.
The patient is given 3L of ringer lactate and subsequently appears less confused, with a blood pressure of 100/70 mmHg.
